purpose: Active Chohogi assets may claim only capabilities backed by the declared evidence path.

assurances.trigger: every Codex task, or explicit use of an installed Chohogi custom role
assurances.nonTrigger: does not select a daily workflow itself or make a project-local role global
assurances.output: direct handling, defer, or conductor handoff; installed bounded Codex role profiles
assurances.limits: does not prove fresh-session model behavior or select a model and effort outside the active session policy

assurances.trigger: substantial work after conductor selection
assurances.nonTrigger: does not replace project implementation or external provider authority
assurances.output: one workflow, allocation, project-local policy discovery, an intent contract and pre-edit consumer-reference map when the change crosses an unfamiliar, dirty, shared, or multi-consumer boundary, isolated build-output discipline around active development servers, browser-verified visual acceptance when required, and mapped visual acceptance including standard breakpoint classification, cross-breakpoint layout consistency, container-width verification, maximum-width treatment for repeated visual assets, separate viewport-versus-container responsibilities, and boundary-adjacent responsive measurements with coordinate-system disclosure when the delivery requires it
assurances.limits: static contracts require bounded replay for durable behavior changes

assurances.trigger: a confirmed failure has a bounded, verified smallest prevention
assurances.nonTrigger: ordinary delivery, unconfirmed incidents, and automatic global promotion
assurances.output: bounded learning disposition and redacted phloem return
assurances.limits: does not automatically promote a project observation or prove future model behavior

assurances.trigger: a whole-harness policy, lifecycle, installation, discovery, or evaluation boundary changes
assurances.nonTrigger: ordinary delivery, product decisions, and a single project bug
assurances.output: bounded Homeostasis disposition and repair packet
assurances.limits: does not itself repair assets or prove fresh-session model behavior

assurances.trigger: verified reusable prevention or provenance review
assurances.nonTrigger: unverified external metadata and one-off project observations
assurances.output: bounded provenance or inheritance state
assurances.limits: is not automatic active discovery

assurances.trigger: a terminal delivery or debugging result needs redacted handoff
assurances.nonTrigger: does not choose route or persist raw evidence
assurances.output: redacted context or feedback packet
assurances.limits: does not execute a scanner or release gate

assurances.trigger: a user-facing semantic or interactive surface changes, or an accessibility review is requested
assurances.nonTrigger: does not select route, authority, or automatically certify WCAG conformance
assurances.output: scoped accessibility method and review guidance
assurances.limits: advisory guidance does not execute an accessibility scanner or establish legal compliance

assurances.trigger: a delivery needs a substantive frontend design, visual audit, bounded redesign, or non-copying study of a user-supplied screenshot or public URL
assurances.nonTrigger: does not select route, overwrite project boundaries, run a visual gate, or certify design, legal, accessibility, performance, or user-research outcomes
assurances.output: a design packet, ranked audit, bounded redesign rationale, or non-copying study diagnosis with specialist handoffs and structured manual review
assurances.limits: advisory guidance cannot prove fatigue reduction, originality, legal permission, or that its structured manual review was mechanically executed

assurances.trigger: agent orchestration, tool calling, MCP use, or agent runtime boundaries change
assurances.nonTrigger: does not select route, approve an agent, or execute a security gate
assurances.output: scoped agent security review method
assurances.limits: advisory guidance does not prove an agent is free of vulnerabilities

assurances.trigger: a delivery requests Core Web Vitals analysis or improvement
assurances.nonTrigger: does not select route or automatically measure production performance
assurances.output: scoped Core Web Vitals optimization method
assurances.limits: advisory guidance does not produce field-performance evidence

assurances.trigger: dependency, lockfile, package-manager, or supply-chain risk changes
assurances.nonTrigger: does not select route or execute a dependency scanner itself
assurances.output: scoped dependency-risk review and scanner interpretation method
assurances.limits: advisory guidance does not establish that a dependency audit ran

assurances.trigger: an MCP server is installed, exposed, or materially changed
assurances.nonTrigger: does not select route, authorize an MCP server, or execute a scanner
assurances.output: scoped MCP security review method
assurances.limits: advisory guidance does not prove a server is safe

assurances.trigger: a delivery requests web performance analysis or improvement
assurances.nonTrigger: does not select route or automatically measure production performance
assurances.output: scoped web performance optimization method
assurances.limits: advisory guidance does not produce field-performance evidence

assurances.trigger: an LLM, RAG, agent, MCP, tool-calling, browsing, or retrieved-content feature changes
assurances.nonTrigger: does not select route or execute an agent-security regression suite itself
assurances.output: scoped prompt-injection review and regression-design method
assurances.limits: advisory guidance does not prove resistance to every prompt injection

assurances.trigger: security-sensitive code changes require review
assurances.nonTrigger: does not select route, approve code, or execute a scanner
assurances.output: scoped secure-code review method
assurances.limits: advisory guidance does not prove absence of vulnerabilities

assurances.trigger: a delivery handles untrusted data, authentication, storage, or external integration
assurances.nonTrigger: does not select route or execute SAST, secret scanning, DAST, or release blocking
assurances.output: scoped security hardening method
assurances.limits: advisory guidance does not establish that a project security gate ran

assurances.trigger: a risk-bearing architecture, API, authentication, external integration, or data flow is designed
assurances.nonTrigger: does not select route or automatically validate an implementation
assurances.output: scoped STRIDE threat-modeling method
assurances.limits: advisory guidance does not prove implementation controls are present

assurances.trigger: an active Chohogi asset or tooling command claims, changes, or depends on a durable function
assurances.nonTrigger: does not select a daily workflow, repair the asset, or prove unexecuted runtime behavior
assurances.output: claim-to-evidence observation and conformance failure when coverage or minimum evidence is absent
assurances.limits: declared evidence is not equivalent to semantic or fresh-session proof

assurances.trigger: an active YAML, JSON, frontmatter, registry, manifest, fixture, or other declared contract is added, changed, installed, or audited
assurances.nonTrigger: does not prove schema-specific behavior, runtime behavior, provider behavior, or fresh-session model adherence
assurances.output: strictly parsed active declaration surface or a nonzero ambiguity failure
assurances.limits: unambiguous syntax and required frontmatter fields are not equivalent to a complete domain schema or functional result

assurances.trigger: a delivery changes a security risk boundary or claims a scanner/release gate
assurances.nonTrigger: ordinary low-risk changes and unexecuted project plans
assurances.output: pre-code security acceptance criteria or a project execution-gate requirement
assurances.limits: static boundary classification does not prove a project scanner ran

assurances.trigger: a project security plan must execute or an external skill payload must be inventoried
assurances.nonTrigger: does not approve external code, replace project review, or execute a plan without --execute
assurances.output: machine-readable project security observation or full skill-payload inventory
assurances.execution: python3 tooling/classify-security-boundary.py ...; python3 tooling/run-security-gate.py ... --execute; or python3 tooling/scan-skill-intake.py ...
assurances.limits: a gate proves configured commands and artifacts, not absence of every vulnerability

assurances.trigger: installation, diagnosis, audit, or backup management
assurances.nonTrigger: does not modify an unowned installation
assurances.output: installed state report, audit result, or guarded migration action
assurances.execution: shell command or Python resolver named by the requested operation
assurances.limits: doctor reports state; graft audit establishes source/install parity

assurances.trigger: an officially exposed model catalog, task role, prior catalog, or verified learning escalation requires a session-policy recommendation or comparison
assurances.nonTrigger: does not discover providers, inspect credentials or private settings, change model selection, or send asynchronous notifications
assurances.output: machine-readable candidates or catalog-change/learning reconfirmation requirement
assurances.limits: only supplied official observations are compared; a ranking is not a quality benchmark, a provider probe, or a billing guarantee

assurances.trigger: a named static contract, topology, or replay record requires validation
assurances.nonTrigger: does not prove unobserved runtime or model behavior
assurances.output: machine-readable result or nonzero conformance failure
assurances.limits: deterministic checks only establish their declared contract
